1510101.name: Rapid-Fire Rifle
1510101.description: Fires a barrage of rifle bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1510102.name: Large Caliber Rifle
1510102.description: Fires six lasers, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1510103.name: Guided Explosive Missile
1510103.description: Fires eight missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

1510104.name: Head Laser
1510104.description: Fires a highly concentrated laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1510105.name: Signal for Help
1510105.description:
Sensing danger, Harvester gathers surrounding Raptures in an attempt to regroup. It generates a code barrier while other Raptures are on the field. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.
Additionally, Harvester becomes enraged, gaining increased ATK.

1510106.name: Spider Stamp
1510106.description: Harvester lowers its front limbs, blocking a single Nikke's vision.

1510107.name: Head Laser Ver.02
1510107.description: Fires a highly concentrated laser that pierces through cover. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.
